description: Following the rise in adaptive cyber probes and the launch of the AI Shield, a coalition of national CERTs and Europol begins developing a shared AI-driven threat intelligence platform, using red-teamed models to simulate cross-border attack chains. The project emerges from operational necessity rather than top-down policy, and marks the first real-time cooperation of its kind. It is small and experimental, but if sustained, could evolve into a de facto joint cyber command.
